about_the_game:
So, the paper curtain falls, and the show begins.

One day, a white rabbit detective named Mr. White receives an unusual case: to find the missing mathematics professor, a eublepharis named Mr. Sturt. However, the investigation becomes significantly more complicated when Mr. White finds... the professor’s body parts. These parts are in excellent health, in a great mood, and in no hurry to return to their original place...

Mr. White’s Agency is a cozy and humorous detective story. It’s so cozy that there isn’t a single murder in the entire game! Instead, you’ll solve mysteries, meet peculiar witnesses, and immerse yourself in a charming paper-theater world where you’re not just a player—you’re the director of a detective play.

A Theater That Knows It’s a Theater

In your theater, the actors are well aware that they are actors. But they don’t mind. In fact, some of them will even try to help you. You might not always appreciate their assistance, but rest assured, their intentions are always good.

How Does the Investigation Work?

  • Mr. White receives a case—and, of course, asks for your help.

  • Using a map, you move your detective between locations, where he interrogates witnesses and records key information in his journal.

  • The investigation will take you to a variety of locations—tree burrows deep in the forest, a house aboard an airship, and even the depths of the ocean.

  • You’ll solve puzzles along the way, uncovering new witnesses and new evidence.

  • Use the clues you’ve gathered to ask witnesses additional questions and dig deeper into the mystery.

  • When you think you’ve solved the case, gather everyone for a cup of tea and prove that you are the best detective in the theater. Together with Mr. White, you’ll explain step by step who did what and why—while answering all the skeptical questions from the witnesses trying to poke holes in your theory.

  • On average, completing one chapter takes 1-3 hours.

Don’t worry if it all sounds complicated! Mr. White is a clever rabbit, and he’ll always guide you on what to do next.

A Cast to Remember

Our story is deeply character-driven. We’ve worked hard to make each character truly unique and memorable:

  • Dolly the Maid, a sheep who hates cleaning but loves fermenting cabbage.

  • Captain Hogg, who is always asleep on a stakeout.

  • Professor Sturt, a brilliant but incredibly rude mathematics professor.

  • A manic mantis surgeon with questionable medical ethics...

So, dear detectives, grab a cup of tea and follow the white rabbit! 🕵️🐇☕

name: Mr. White's Agency
short_description: A cozy detective story for those who love deduction but hate murders. Gather clues, work in your journal, and question quirky witnesses! You need to come up with a theory of what happened and be able to prove it.
supported_languages:
English*, Russian
*languages with full audio support
